exercise.title: Physical Exertion / Sympathetic Activation
exercise.hypothesis: Elevated cardiac output driven by chronotropy and inotropy with moderate systolic rise and widened pulse pressure.
exercise.disclaimer: NOTICE: This is an in-silico mathematical simulation intended strictly for research and educational demonstration. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical prediction.

beta_blocker.title: Beta-Adrenergic Blockade (e.g. Metoprolol)
beta_blocker.hypothesis: Reduction in myocardial oxygen demand, decreased cardiac output, and reduction in systolic arterial pressure.
beta_blocker.disclaimer: NOTICE: This is an in-silico mathematical simulation intended strictly for research and educational demonstration. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical prediction.

vasodilator.title: Arterial Vasodilation (e.g. ACE Inhibitor / CCB)
vasodilator.hypothesis: Significant drop in mean and diastolic arterial pressure with facilitated ventricular ejection.
vasodilator.disclaimer: NOTICE: This is an in-silico mathematical simulation intended strictly for research and educational demonstration. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical prediction.

heart_failure.title: Systolic Heart Failure / Reduced Contractility (HFrEF)
heart_failure.hypothesis: Substantial decline in stroke volume and ejection fraction (<40%) with narrowed pulse pressure.
heart_failure.disclaimer: NOTICE: This is an in-silico mathematical simulation intended strictly for research and educational demonstration. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical prediction.

arterial_stiffening.title: Isolated Systolic Hypertension / Aging Aorta
arterial_stiffening.hypothesis: Marked elevation in systolic blood pressure and wide pulse pressure due to reduced arterial buffering.
arterial_stiffening.disclaimer: NOTICE: This is an in-silico mathematical simulation intended strictly for research and educational demonstration. It does NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical prediction.
